description: その他の公共施設 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター). その他の公共施設のデータです。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 10 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 10 publishers. Its tags are その他, 公共施設, 磐田市, 静岡県. It offers 3 resource(s) in rdf, txt, xls. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
